# Justice Equity Need Index Component Results {.tabset .tabset-fade}

## Inequity Drivers
```{r}
# severity: [ "rgb(239,243,255)", "rgb(189,215,231)", "rgb(107,174,214)", "rgb(49,130,189)", "rgb(8,81,156)" ],​

#blue
pal_impact <- colorBin(palette = c("#eff3ff","#bdd7e7", "#6baed6", "#3182bd","#08519c"), domain = jeni$drivers_pctl, bins = 5, reverse = FALSE, pretty = FALSE)

#create popup
popup <- paste("<div class='hasjeni'><div class='drivers-leaflet-data' data-zip='", jeni$zipcode,
               "' data-neighborhood='",jeni$lat_neighborhood,
               "' data-jeni-pctl='",jeni$jeni_pctl,
               "' data-jeni-category='",jeni$jeni_category,
               "' data-jeni-rank='",jeni$jeni_rank,
               "' data-population='",prettyNum(jeni$population_count, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none"),
               "' data-sd-number='",jeni$sd_number,
               "' data-sd-name='",jeni$sd_name,
               "' data-spa-number='",jeni$spa_number,
               "' data-spa-name='",jeni$spa_name,
               "' data-system-category='",jeni$system_category,
               "' data-drivers-category='",jeni$drivers_category,
               "' data-risk-category='",jeni$risk_category,
               "' data-system-pctl='",jeni$system_pctl,
               "' data-drivers-pctl='",jeni$drivers_pctl,
               "' data-risk-pctl='",jeni$risk_pctl,
               "' data-black-rate='",jeni$black_rate,
               "' data-latinx-rate='",jeni$latinx_rate,
               "' data-aian-rate='",jeni$aian_rate,
               "' data-nhpi-rate='",jeni$nhpi_rate,
               "' data-unemployed-rate='",jeni$unemployed_rate,
               "' data-nohighschool-rate='",jeni$nohighschool_rate,
               "' data-below200fpl-rate='",jeni$below200fpl_rate,
               "' data-vc-rate='",jeni$vc_rate,
               "' data-homeless-rate='",jeni$homeless_rate,
               "' data-alcdrug-hosp-rate='",jeni$alcdrug_hosp_rate,
               "' data-mentalhlth-hosp-rate='",jeni$mentalhlth_hosp_rate,
               "'></div></div>")

# create custom legend labels
labels <- c(
"Lowest (0-19th Percentile)",
"Low (20-39th Percentile)",
"Moderate (40-59th Percentile)",
"High (60-79th Percentile)",
"Highest (80-100th Percentile)")

# build map
leaflet(jeni, width = "100%", height = "600px", options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%

# new code: add base map
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_nolabels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>'
    ) %>%
    addTiles(
      urlTemplate = paste0("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_only_labels/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=", carto_key),
      # attribution = '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>, &copy; <a href="https://carto.com/attributions">CARTO</a>',
      options = providerTileOptions(pane = "markerPane") # retain unique setting 
    ) %>%
# add map panes
addMapPane("index_pane", zIndex = 400) %>%
addMapPane("missing_pane", zIndex = 410) %>%
  # addMapPane("jeni_2019", zIndex = 415) %>%
  addMapPane("jesi_2021", zIndex = 415) %>%
addMapPane("sds_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%
addMapPane("spas_pane", zIndex = 420) %>%


# set view and layer control
  setView(-118.6368454, 34.2324274, zoom = 8.5) %>%
addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Supervisorial Districts","Service Planning Areas", 
                                   # "JENI 2019 - High/Highest Need ZIP Codes", 
                                   "JESI - Low/Lowest Service ZIP Codes"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE, autoZIndex = TRUE)) %>%

# create sidebar and add html for content
           
addControl(html='<div class="leaflet-popup-scrolled" id="sidebar1"><div class ="zipcode-header"  style="margin-bottom: 8px; margin-top: 8px;"><span class="square-icon"></span><span class="zip" style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold;"></span></div><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.5em;">Inequity Drivers Percentile*: </span><span class="drivers-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> | <span class="drivers-category color-format-drivers" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-drivers"></div></div></span><br><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;">JENI & Other Component Percentiles*</span><br><span style="font-size: 12px;">JENI:  <span class="jeni-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-jeni"></div></div><br>System Involvement:  <span class="system-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-system"></div></div><br>Criminalization Risk:  <span class="risk-pctl" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-risk"></div></div><br><br><span style="line-height: 1.5em; font-size: 12px; display: block; width: 95%;"><span class="zip-details" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> has a <span class="drivers-category-details color-format-drivers"></span> Inequity Drivers need level. It also scores<span class="system-category color-format-system"></span> on System Involvement, <span class="risk-category color-format-risk"></span> on Criminalization Risk, and <span class="jeni-category color-format-jeni"></span> on JENI overall.<br><br>Neighborhood:  <span class="neighborhood" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>JENI Rank: <span class="jeni-rank" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> out of 277 ZIP Codes<br>Population:  <span class="population" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Supervisorial District:  <span class="sd-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span>  |  <span class="sd-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Service Planning Area: <span class="spa-number" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span> |  <span class="spa-name" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><br><span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;">Indicators</span><br>% Black Population: <span class="black-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>% Latinx Population: <span class="latinx-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>% American Indian / Alaskan Native Population: <span class="aian-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>% Native Hawaiian / Pacific Islander Population: <span class="nhpi-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Unemployment Rate: <span class="unemployed-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>% of Population without High School Diploma: <span class="nohighschool-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Below 200% Poverty Level Rate: <span class="below200fpl-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br>Violent Crime Rate (per 1K): <span class="vc-rate" style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold;"></span><br><br><span style="font-size: 10px; font-style: italic;">*Percentiles range from 0-100. A higher percentile means a higher level of need in that area.</span></span></div>', position = "topleft") %>%
  
  
# add polygons for JENI ZIP Codes
addPolygons(color = "black", weight = 1, smoothFactor = 0.5, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            fillOpacity = .8, fillColor = ~pal_impact(drivers_pctl), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 5, bringToFront = TRUE, sendToBack = TRUE),
popup = ~popup,
group = "JENI", options = pathOptions(pane = "index_pane")) %>%

# add polygons for ZIP Codes wit no jeni
  addPolygons(data=nojeni,color="#444444", weight = 1, smoothFactor = 0.5, 
              opacity = 1.0,
              fillOpacity = .8, fillColor ="#808080", highlight = highlightOptions(color = "#444444", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE, sendToBack = TRUE)
,
popup = ~paste0(
"ZIP Code:<b> ", nojeni$zipcode, "</b></br>",
"No JENI Available</br>Population:<b> ", nojeni$population_count, "</b></br>"),
options = pathOptions(pane = "missing_pane")
)%>%

 # add boundaries for lowest service JESI 2021 Zips
addPolygons(data = jesi_2021_lowest, 
            opacity= 1.0,
            fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~zipcode, group = "JESI - Low/Lowest Service ZIP Codes", options = pathOptions(pane = "jesi_2021", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%
  
# add boundaries for SPAs and SDs
addPolygons(data = sds, 
            opacity = 1.0,
            dashArray = "10 5",
            fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~distname, group = "Supervisorial Districts", options = pathOptions(pane = "sds_pane", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%
  addPolygons(data = spas, 
              opacity=1.0,
              dashArray = "5 5",
              fillOpacity=0, color = "black", weight = 2.5, label=~spa_2012, group = "Service Planning Areas", options = pathOptions(pane = "spas_pane", interactive = FALSE), highlight = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 3, bringToFront = TRUE)) %>%
```

```{r}
popup <- paste("<div class='hasjeni'><div class='risk-leaflet-data' data-zip='", jeni$zipcode,

               "' data-population='",prettyNum(jeni$population_count, big.mark = ",", preserve.width = "none"),
               "' data-sd-number='",jeni$sd_number,
               "' data-sd-name='",jeni$sd_name,
               "' data-spa-number='",jeni$spa_number,
               "' data-spa-name='",jeni$spa_name,
```
